newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Helicopter sells Airod stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Helicopter sells Airod stake.

text.p: Malaysian Helicopter Services Bhd (MHS) has agreed to sell its entire 53 percent stake in Airod Sdn Bhd to PJS Industries Sdn Bhd, the national Bernama news agency reported.

Quoting a statement from MHS, Bernama said late on Friday that the disposal to unlisted PJS comprised all of its 19.34 million shares of Airod holding company Aerospace Industries Malaysia for 28.1 million ringgit and 2.99 million shares of Airod for 4.9 million ringgit.
Part of the MHS stake in Airod had been held through its 66.7 percent interest in Aerospace Industries.
MHS offficials were not available for comment on Saturday.

Airod (Aircraft Inspection Repair and Overhaul Depot) is the principal aircraft repair and overhaul facility in Malaysia. It services aircraft from the Royal Malaysian Air Force as well as those of other air forces and commercial operators.

The disposal of the shares is not expected to have any material effect on the earnings per share and the net tangible assets of MHS Group for the current financial year ended Dec 31, 1996, the statement said.
